questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

20 : 480 :: 25 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number² + (First number × 4)**

20 : 480 → 20² + (20 × 4) = 400 + 80 = 480

Similarly,

25 : ? → 25² + (25 × 4) = 625 + 100 =** 725**

Hence, the correct answer is **"725".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’, and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression ?

100 D (1 B 4) A 2 B (13 A 11) C 3 B (17 C 12)
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d7160f0c4ffebf9d2c466435f18cce1bca631cc9d708d82720d54056afbdef9.png] 

‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’, and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’,

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 **Symbols**
 
 

 A
 +
 
 

 B
 × 
 
 

 C
 -
 
 

 D
 ÷ 
 
 

 

Given equation is : 100 D (1 B 4) A 2 B (13 A 11) C 3 B (17 C 12)

By inserting the given symbols the equation formed is as follows : 

100 ÷ (1 × 4) + 2 × (13 + 11) - 3 × (17 - 12)

= 100 ÷ (__**1 × 4**__) + 2 × (__**13 + 11**__) - 3 × (__**17 - 12**__)

= __**100 ÷ 4**__ + 2 × 24 - 3 × 5

= 25 + __**2 × 24**__ - __**3 × 5**__

= __**25 + 48**__ - 15

= **__73 - 15__**

= 58

Hence, the correct answer is **"58".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

A _ _ B _ _ A B _ C A _ B B C

options.text: B, C, A, A, A, B
B, A, B, A, C, B
A, B, C, A, B, A
B, B, C, C, A, B

questions.solution:
Given : A _ _ B _ _ A B _ C A _ B B C

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1. B, C, A, A, A, B → A **__B C__ **B **__A__ / __A__ **A B __**A**__ C / A __**B**__ B B C

2. B, A, B, A, C, B → A **__B A__ **B **__B__ / __A__ **A B __**C**__ C / A __**B**__ B B C

3. A, B, C, A, B, A → A** __A B__ **B **__C__ / __A__ **A B __**B**__ C / A __**A**__ B B C

4. B, B, C, C, A, B → A **B B** B **C / C** A B **A** C / A **B** B B C

Option (3) gives a pattern of : __A A B B ____C__ - A A B B C **-** __A ____A B B C__

Hence, the correct answer is **" A, B, C, A, B, A".**

questions.question: If the diagonal of a square is increased by 4 cm, its area increases by 56 cm² . Find the ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square.
questions.solution:
Area of Square (A₁) = S² ................... (1)

Length of diagonal (d₁) = sqrt{2} S .............. (2)

From eq(2) → S = d₁/sqrt{2}

Area of square (A₁) = (d₁/sqrt{2})²

A₁ = (d₁)²/2 ........... (3)

∴ The diagonal of the square increased by 4cm and its area increased by 56cm².

Increased diagonal of square (d₂) = d₁ + 4 ........... (4)

Increased area of square (A₂) = A₁ + 56 .......... (5)

A₂ = (d₂)²/2

From eq (3) we get, 

A₂ = (d₁ + 4)²/2 .......... (6)

From eq (4) we get,

A₂ - A₁ = 56 .......... (7)

Substitute eq (3) and eq (6) in eq (7)

⇒ (d1 + 4)2/2 - (d1)2/2 = 56

⇒ (d₁ + 4)² - (d1)2 = 56 × 2

⇒ (d1 + 4)2 - (d1)2 = 112

⇒ (d₁)² + 8d₁ + 16 - (d1)2 = 112

⇒ 8d1 + 16 = 112

⇒ 8d1 = 112 - 16

⇒ 8d1 = 96

⇒ d₁ = 12

∴ d₂ = d₁ + 4

d₂ = 12 + 4 = 16

Ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square = A₂ / A₁

A₂ / A₁ = ((d2)2/2) / ((d1)2/2 )

A2 / A₁ = (16² / 2) / (12² / 2)

A2 / A₁ = (256 / 2) / (144 / 2)

A2 / A₁ = 128 / 72

A2 / A₁ = 16 / 9

∴ Here, the Ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square **A₂ : A₁** **= 16 : 9**

Hence, the correct answer is **"16 : 9".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some cats are animals.

All animals are plants.

Conclusions:

I. All cats are plants.

II. Some plants are cats.

III. Some plants are animals.

IV. All animals are cats.

options.text: Only conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bde2cd194036d63fb1baaff1ba6877a57169536b5241a0632c3062832c6e9a7.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All cats are plants → False (As Some cats are animals and All animals are plants so, some cats can be plants but all cats are plants is definitely False)

II. Some plants are cats → True (As All animals are plants and Some cats are animals so, Some plants are cats it is definitely true)

III. Some plants are animals → True (As All animals are plants so, Some plants are animals it is definitely true)

IV. All animals are cats → False (Some cats are animals so, All animals are cats it is definitely false)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusions II and III follow".**
